description: NMD boundary analysis and de novo mutation rate based incidence estimate for TANC2
code:
import requests, json, time
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
hdr={"Content-Type":"application/json"}
lk=requests.get("https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/symbol/homo_sapiens/TANC2",params={"expand":1},headers=hdr,timeout=60).json()
best=max([t for t in lk["Transcript"] if t.get("Translation")],key=lambda t:t["Translation"]["length"])
exons=sorted([(e["start"],e["end"]) for e in best["Exon"]])
cds_s,cds_e=best["Translation"]["start"],best["Translation"]["end"]
blocks=[(max(s,cds_s),min(e,cds_e)) for s,e in exons if max(s,cds_s)<=min(e,cds_e)]
TOT=sum(b-a+1 for a,b in blocks); NMD=sum(b-a+1 for a,b in blocks[:-1])-50
def g2c(p):
    c=0
    for a,b in blocks:
        if a<=p<=b: return c+(p-a)+1
        c+=b-a+1
    return None

# ClinVar P/LP truncating -> CDS position
eut="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def get(u,p,t=6):
    for _ in range(t):
        r=requests.get(u,params=p,timeout=120)
        try: return r.json()
        except Exception: time.sleep(3)
    raise RuntimeError
ids=get(eut+"esearch.fcgi",{"db":"clinvar","term":'TANC2[gene]',"retmax":1000,"retmode":"json"})["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
cv=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    res=get(eut+"esummary.fcgi",{"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+200]),"retmode":"json"}).get("result",{})
    for uid in res.get("uids",[]):
        x=res[uid]; g=x.get("germline_classification",{}); vs=(x.get("variation_set") or [{}])[0]
        loc=[l for l in vs.get("variation_loc",[]) if l.get("assembly_name")=="GRCh38" and l.get("start")]
        cv.append({"title":x.get("title",""),"clinsig":g.get("description",""),"pos":int(loc[0]["start"]) if loc else None})
    time.sleep(1.0)
C=pd.DataFrame(cv)
tr=C[C.clinsig.isin(["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"]) &
     C.title.str.contains(r"fs\)|Ter\)",regex=True,na=False) & ~C.title.str.contains("GRCh",na=False)].dropna(subset=["pos"]).copy()
tr["cds"]=tr.pos.apply(g2c); tr=tr.dropna(subset=["cds"]); tr["cds"]=tr.cds.astype(int)

# gnomAD HC pLoF
q="""query { gene(gene_symbol:"TANC2", reference_genome:GRCh38){ variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ pos transcript_consequence{lof} exome{ac an} } } }"""
dd=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",json={"query":q},timeout=300).json()["data"]["gene"]["variants"]
H=pd.DataFrame([{"pos":v["pos"],"ac":(v.get("exome") or {}).get("ac") or 0,"an":(v.get("exome") or {}).get("an") or 0}
                for v in dd if (v.get("transcript_consequence") or {}).get("lof")=="HC"])
H["cds"]=H.pos.apply(g2c); H=H.dropna(subset=["cds"]); H["cds"]=H.cds.astype(int); AN=H.an.max()

print("CDS %d bp (%d codons). Last coding exon starts at CDS %d (%.1f%%); NMD-escape boundary CDS %d (%.1f%%)"%(
    TOT,TOT//3,TOT-(blocks[-1][1]-blocks[-1][0]+1)+1,100*(TOT-(blocks[-1][1]-blocks[-1][0]))/TOT,NMD,100*NMD/TOT))
print("\nClinVar P/LP truncating mapped: n=%d"%len(tr))
print("  in NMD-triggering region: %d (%.0f%%)   NMD-escaping (last exon -50nt): %d (%.0f%%)"%(
    (tr.cds<=NMD).sum(),100*(tr.cds<=NMD).mean(),(tr.cds>NMD).sum(),100*(tr.cds>NMD).mean()))
print("gnomAD HC pLoF alleles (exomes, AC-weighted): total AC=%d"%H.ac.sum())
print("  in NMD-triggering region: AC=%d (%.0f%%)   NMD-escaping: AC=%d (%.0f%%)"%(
    H[H.cds<=NMD].ac.sum(),100*H[H.cds<=NMD].ac.sum()/H.ac.sum(),H[H.cds>NMD].ac.sum(),100*H[H.cds>NMD].ac.sum()/H.ac.sum()))
tab=np.array([[ (tr.cds<=NMD).sum(), (tr.cds>NMD).sum() ],
              [ int(H[H.cds<=NMD].ac.sum()), int(H[H.cds>NMD].ac.sum()) ]])
orr,p=stats.fisher_exact(tab)
print("\nFisher exact, disease truncating vs population pLoF alleles x (NMD-triggering vs escaping):")
print("  table",tab.tolist()," OR=%.2f  p=%.3g"%(orr,p))

# ---- de novo LoF rate and predicted birth incidence ----
mu_bp=1.25e-8           # per-base per-haploid-genome per generation SNV rate (Kong 2012)
f_nonsense=0.044        # fraction of random coding SNVs creating a stop codon
splice_sites=2*2*(len(blocks)-1)   # canonical +-1,+-2 donor/acceptor bases
mu_snv_lof = 2*mu_bp*(TOT*f_nonsense + splice_sites*0.75)
mu_indel   = 0.10*mu_snv_lof*1.5   # frameshift indels, ~15% of de novo LoF events
mu_lof = mu_snv_lof+mu_indel
print("\nDe novo LoF rate estimate for TANC2: CDS=%d bp, %d canonical splice bases"%(TOT,splice_sites))
print("  mu_LoF = %.2e per birth  ->  predicted birth incidence 1 in %.0f if fully penetrant and all de novo"%(mu_lof,1/mu_lof))
print("  per 100,000 births: %.2f"%(1e5*mu_lof))
caf_all=H.ac.sum()/AN; caf_nmd=H[H.cds<=NMD].ac.sum()/AN
print("\ngnomAD population carrier frequency of HC pLoF: all = 1 in %.0f ; NMD-triggering only = 1 in %.0f"%(1/(2*caf_all),1/(2*caf_nmd)))
print("  ratio population carriers / predicted incidence = %.1fx"%((2*caf_nmd)/mu_lof))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,5))
ax.axvspan(NMD,TOT,color="#FFE9A8",zorder=0)
ax.text((NMD+TOT)/2,1.28,"last coding exon (-50 nt):\npremature stops escape NMD",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="0.3")
ax.scatter(tr.cds,np.full(len(tr),1.05),s=45,color="#C44E52",zorder=3,label="ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic truncating (n=%d)"%len(tr))
hh=H[H.ac>0]
ax.scatter(hh.cds,np.full(len(hh),0.75),s=np.clip(hh.ac*8,18,350),color="#4C72B0",alpha=.55,zorder=3,
           label="gnomAD v4 exome pLoF, size = allele count (n=%d)"%len(hh))
ax.set_xlim(-100,TOT+100); ax.set_ylim(0.5,1.45); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("CDS position in TANC2 transcript ENST00000689528 (%d bp, %d codons)"%(TOT,TOT//3))
ax.legend(loc="lower left",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("TANC2 truncating variants: disease alleles occur throughout the CDS, while population\nloss-of-function alleles concentrate in the NMD-escaping last exon (Fisher OR = %.2f, p = %.1e)"%(orr,p),fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
